purpose: Test whether a point-in-time objective slice of RK-MIS Growth Execution plus Financial Quality improves 3-year multibagger concentration and downside filtering.
entry_rule: first valid NSE EQ trading day strictly after anchor_date
outcome_rule: last valid NSE EQ trading day on or before outcome_target_date

filing_window.point_in_time_rule: period_end <= anchor and filing/broadcast known_at <= anchor
filing_window.revision_rule: for each period/scope use the latest version that was already known by the anchor; reject post-anchor versions

exclude_from_industrial_slice_if: pre-anchor company name contains finance, financial, finserv, credit, leasing, securities, or housing finance
business_model_guard.reason: Industrial leverage, interest-coverage and EBITDA-margin bands are not comparable for banks/NBFCs.

score_rule: Use existing frozen rk_mie_scoring.json bands. For each company, sum earned effective weights over available replay-grade features and normalize by covered effective weight. Ranking eligibility requires at least 70% of the 9.2-point slice weight covered. Missing data is never imputed as zero.
explicit_non_claims: This is not the full Growth Runway pillar because TAM, market-share headroom, reinvestment runway and sector-tailwind evidence are not reconstructed here.
This is not the full Financial Quality pillar because ROCE, ROE, CFO/PAT and working-capital quality are not reconstructed here.
This does not measure Business Moat or Future Catalysts.
No official 100-point weight may be changed from one holdout.

outcome_safety.corporate_actions: deterministic factors only; unresolved material actions fail closed

evaluation.decision_rule: Positive diagnostic requires higher mean multiple or 5x concentration, no >5pp adverse loss-rate delta, and non-negative rank correlation. Otherwise no weight increase and investigate individual components only in a future preregistered holdout.
